title: Content inciting or justifying exclusion and restriction behaviors towards specific language use
source_text: Content inciting or justifying exclusion and restriction behaviors towards specific language use: not allowing use of a certain language in public, should ban a certain language from entering education system, should reduce media spread of a certain language;

elements.label: Language-based exclusion and restriction
elements.risk_pattern: Unfair or biased tendencies that incite or justify exclusionary or restrictive behaviors toward specific language use.
bias_surfaces: framing certain languages as inferior or illegitimate
advocating for legal or institutional bans on language use
promoting monolingual norms as universally preferable
linking language use to national disloyalty or threat
denying linguistic rights in public or educational domains
justifying suppression of minority languages for assimilation
equating language preference with moral or intellectual deficiency

quality_warnings: Risk of conflation between language and ethnicity/nationality remains despite constraints; future items must actively decouple these unless explicitly tied in source material.
Bias surfaces are well-abstracted but may still invite examples centered on widely recognized minority languages; generation should ensure coverage across global linguistic contexts.
